data.title: 厄普西隆 · 夜空天台的隐形魔力丝线
data.description: 王都钟塔尖顶的冷风呼啸，厄普西隆十指轻弹，指尖延伸出无数道如琴弦般晶莹剔透的暗影魔力丝线，紫眸在夜色中绽放从容敏锐的自信。
data.location: soaring gothic clocktower pinnacle overlooking sprawling capital city lights
data.action: standing poised with ten fingertips extended, conjuring razor-sharp glowing magical threads like harp strings, confident sly smile
data.lighting: cool starlight and cyan magical thread glow illuminating pale face and light blue hair
data.mood: masterful precision, deadly assassin beauty, unshakeable confidence
data.promptProse: On a clocktower roof at night, light blue-haired elf Epsilon extends glowing magical threads from her fingertips with a confident smirk.
data.animaCaption: Epsilon controlling invisible magical threads from the clocktower pinnacle.
